name: drift-fixture
comment: The CANDIDATE side of the VC-010 drift pair: the same tree one patch release later. depsnort-fixture-drift 1.6.3 kept the postinstall it had at 1.6.2 and added named-credential access and network egress to it. depsnort-fixture-stable is unchanged and must produce no drift finding. Both names were VERIFIED absent from the npm registry (D-16).
